selection: Four adaptive rounds; minimize score on simulated positives, maximize on simulated benign false-alarm controls; retain original if no improvement.
input_deduplication: Per case and model, skip already queried encodings or numeric feature vectors.
functionality_validation: HTTP 200, exact content type and per-case response-body SHA256 using loopback connection and logical Host header; no redirects or scripts.
fixture_application_policy: Known tenant and opaque case ID, fixed decoded leaf, arbitrary directory aliases; ignores campaign/theme and fragments.
limitations: Constructed .test fixtures and simulated positive/negative behaviours; not verified real phishing pages or natural traffic.
Byte-identical local HTTP responses validate only this explicitly alias-aware, script-free fixture application.
Logical hosts are simulated tenants; this does not demonstrate abuse of an actual legitimate provider.
No live URL or credential-collection functionality is accessed; there is no demonstrated preservation of a real malicious payload.
A four-round best-so-far score-guided search is evaluated under a maximum 16 new queries per case per model; not a complete adaptive-attacker evaluation.
All labels and transformations are fixed before inference. Results must remain separate from corpus test metrics and external validation.
No deployment, local Ghanaian effectiveness, human-user behaviour or universal robustness claim is supported.
